title: Have You Eaten Yet – Wistwell (Official Audio)
desc:
You can carry the whole world all year.
Then you walk in the door and the first thing they ask is: "Have you eaten yet?"

🎵 Have You Eaten Yet · Wistwell
New songs every day. Subscribe if this one found you at the right time.

#christmas #christmas2026 #christmasmusic #HaveYouEatenYet #Wistwell

I was gonna say I'm happy, say the year went well

She just takes my winter coat and pulls me in

And that one little question makes me little again
